headline: The window has given up the day.
body: The lamp is a small circle now, and past it the desk has gone the colour of the wall. High in the glass the sky is still a thin blue. A bus brakes at the corner and does not stop.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: last blue at the top of the glass

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: a bus brakes, does not stop
